priorities.heading: Lower Costs and Cut Taxes for Working Families
priorities.quote: In Congress, Eugene is working to crack down on anti-competitive business practices, lower costs for working families, support small businesses, and ensure economic development creates opportunity in every community.

priorities.heading: Fighting Corruption in Washington
priorities.quote: To restore faith in government, he is leading the congressional efforts to ban Members of Congress from participating in prediction markets and from lobbying their former colleagues after leaving office.

priorities.heading: Stand with Servicemembers, Veterans, and Military Families
priorities.quote: On the House Armed Services Committee, he’s fighting to lower everyday costs for military families, expand access to high-quality health care, strengthen mental health services, and ensure every veteran receives the benefits they’ve earned.

cost-of-living.heading: Lower Costs and Cut Taxes for Working Families
cost-of-living.quote: In Congress, Eugene is working to crack down on anti-competitive business practices, lower costs for working families, support small businesses, and ensure economic development creates opportunity in every community.

housing.note: The site mentions bills to lower housing costs for military families, but doesn't say what he would do about housing in general.

health-care.heading: Lower Health Care Costs and Protect Access to Care
health-care.quote: In Congress, he’s working to lower the cost of prescription drugs, strengthen the Affordable Care Act, protect Medicare and Medicaid, and close the gaps in access that leave too many communities behind.

immigration.heading: Welcoming Legal Immigrants While Securing America’s Borders
immigration.quote: Eugene supports cracking down on transnational crime and violent criminals, alongside simpler, legal pathways for people who pay their taxes and are trying to do things the right way.

foreign-policy.heading: Strengthen Alliances and Defend America from Global Threats
foreign-policy.quote: As a member of the House Armed Services Committee, Eugene is committed to strengthening our global alliances and ensuring our military remains equipped, ready, and capable of confronting the threats of today and tomorrow.

climate-energy.heading: Protect Our Environment and Address Climate Change
climate-energy.quote: He supports bold investments in clean energy, efforts to reduce carbon emissions, transitioning away from fossil fuels, lowering energy bills for Virginians and policies that position Virginia as a leader in the green economy.
